meta.name: debug-broken-ui
meta.description: Find out why something in a running web app does not work, when the console is empty and the code looks correct. Reads the click, the request, the store and the console together and returns the file:line to open. Use when a button does nothing, a form will not submit, data will not load, a page renders blank or stale, a modal will not close, or the user says "it's broken" and the code review says it is fine.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出运行时网页按钮失灵、表单不提交、页面白屏的根因,直接告诉你该打开哪个文件哪一行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果控制台没有报错、代码看着也没问题,却找不到页面为什么不工作
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the console is empty and the code looks fine, yet you can't find what's broken

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从正在运行的应用里读取点击、请求、状态存储和控制台这几路证据,判断故障出在哪一环,并给出要打开的 file:line。如果 Reticle 未安装,会先引导完成安装。
howto.when: 当按钮没反应、表单提交失败、页面空白等,或用户说「坏了」而代码看着没问题时接管。

say.text: 这个按钮点了没反应,控制台也没报错,帮我查一下
say.note: 会复现这次点击,返回要打开的 file:line

say.text: 页面数据加载不出来,代码我检查过没问题
say.note: 会一起读请求、状态存储和控制台

say.text: 弹窗关不掉,帮我复现并定位问题
say.note: 以位置而不是猜测结束排查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the click, request, store and console from the running app, works out which one broke, and returns the file:line to open.
howto.when_en: Use when a button does nothing, a form will not submit, data will not load, or a page renders blank while the code looks fine.

say_en.text: This button does nothing and the console is empty — find it.
say_en.note: Replays the click and returns a file:line.

say_en.text: The data will not load, and the code looks correct to me.
say_en.note: Reads network, store and console together.

say_en.text: This modal will not close — reproduce it and locate the fault.
say_en.note: Ends with a location, not a theory.
